10 open-source iRobot projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered iRobot Roomba robot vacuums. 7 of 10 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: dorita980, Roomba980-Python, rest980, homebridge-roomba, ha_roomba_plus.
